issues.description: StockIngredient constructor signature mismatch: the problem statement (class diagram) and the solution implement a 3-argument constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity). The template repository's StockIngredient class instead provides only a 4-argument constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity, boolean strictValidation). This discrepancy will cause compilation errors or confusion when students (or the provided Main example) instantiate StockIngredient with three arguments (e.g., new StockIngredient("Bacon", 10, 50)).
issues.suggestedFix: Add a public 3-argument constructor StockIngredient(String name, int price, int quantity) to the template repository (either implement it directly or overload and delegate to the existing 4-arg constructor). Ensure the 3-arg constructor enforces the same validation/behavior expected by the exercise (non-null name fallback, non-negative price and quantity) so examples in Main and the problem description compile and behave consistently with the solution.
